Up to 100 sequences and 50,000 residues per request. For larger jobs, use the standalone package.

Phobius predicts transmembrane topology and signal peptides from a single hidden Markov model. Please cite Käll, Krogh & Sonnhammer, J Mol Biol 338:1027-1036 (2004).
